rationale: Material prompt requirement: For a supplied gene and condition, produce a clinical-variant evidence table restricted to variants classified as pathogenic or likely pathogenic with at least a specified review-status threshold. Source anchor "## When to Use": It can retrieve gene/rsID variants, clinical-significance strings, and coordinates, but explicitly lacks the full ClinVar fields needed for the required evidence table.. On that source-visible basis, the source is a meaningful neighbouring route but misses the stated boundary Boundary noted in the sealed assessment: ClinVar-level review-status thresholds, condition associations, submitter assertions, and conflicting-classification reporting..
